items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: But there was another good trumpet player in the band that played a lot of the beautiful solos and that was Dud Bascomb.

ctx.x: And Dud Bascomb, of course, and a trumpet player that got killed. I can't think of his name right offhand. Of course, the two trombone players, they died.
